selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: When many people fought against the Prophet’s message, how did he act?
questions.answer: He stayed brave and firm.

questions.question: Who are some groups that stood against him in this passage?
questions.answer: Big governments, other religions, and even his own people, tribe, and uncle.

questions.question: What does his success in spreading Islam show about him?
questions.answer: It shows he was very strong and special in giving the message.

questions.question: How strong was his faith?
questions.answer: His faith was amazingly strong and wide.

questions.question: What could not shake his faith?
questions.answer: The ideas, beliefs, and teachings around him could not make him doubt.

questions.question: Did fear or worry weaken his trust in Allah?
questions.answer: No. His trust stayed steady.

questions.question: Who learned from his faith after him?
questions.answer: The Companions and other holy believers in later times.

questions.question: What did those believers think about his level of faith?
questions.answer: They saw it as the highest level.

questions.question: What does the traveler decide about a person with such message, worship, prayer, calling, and faith?
questions.answer: Such a person would not lie or trick people.

questions.question: What is one main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet was unmatched in courage and faith, so he was truthful.

questions.question: What job was the Prophet doing in this passage?
questions.answer: He was sharing Allah’s message and calling people to the truth.

questions.question: What good qualities did he show while doing that job?
questions.answer: He showed steadiness, strength, and courage.

questions.question: How do we know he did not back away?
questions.answer: He did not show fear, worry, or hesitation.

questions.question: Was opposition only from faraway people, or also from people close to him?
questions.answer: It was also from people close to him.

questions.question: What happened in the end when he called people to Islam?
questions.answer: Islam became powerful in the world.

questions.question: What word best tells about his faith: weak, unsure, or matchless?
questions.answer: Matchless.

questions.question: What kinds of things tried and failed to create doubt in him?
questions.answer: Popular beliefs, philosophers’ ideas, and religious teachings.

questions.question: Who are named as the first and strongest believers after him?
questions.answer: The Companions.

questions.question: From what picture does the passage say later believers took faith?
questions.answer: From his fountain of faith.

questions.question: Why does the traveler say lying does not fit him?
questions.answer: Because someone with such unique faith, worship, prayer, and truthfulness would not be false.

questions.question: In calling people to the truth, what three qualities are highlighted first?
questions.answer: Firmness, steadfastness, and courage.

questions.question: What makes his courage even more amazing?
questions.answer: So many enemies opposed him, even his own relatives and people.

questions.question: What did he not show, even a little?
questions.answer: He did not show doubt, fear, or nervousness.

questions.question: What result came from his struggle to spread the message?
questions.answer: He overcame the world’s challenge and Islam rose high.
